exit 0
--- stdout
Stop the Liza system by setting config.mode to STOPPED in state.yaml.
Agents will detect the STOPPED mode and exit cleanly at their next check.
This provides a graceful shutdown of all agents.
This is different from pause:
- PAUSED: Agents block and wait for resume
- STOPPED: Agents exit (must be restarted manually)
Use this for:
- Ending a work session
- System maintenance requiring agent restart
- Shutting down before system updates
Usage:
liza stop [flags]
Flags:
--changed-by string identifier for audit trail (overrides LIZA_AGENT_ID env var, defaults to 'human')
-h, --help help for stop
--reason string reason for stopping the system
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
